object_description: compact rectangular four-level volume with a ring around a central core
design_condition: The compact rectangular building is positioned along the western avenue, nestles into the terrain, preserves the prominence of neighbouring buildings, and opens the entrance space toward distant views.

positive.statement: Its sobriety and strong dynamic relate effectively to the existing constructions.
Its position and rectangular proportions avoid relegating a neighbouring building and open the entrance space.
The building nestles into the land and uses a depression to bring natural light to lower-level spaces.
The typology is clear and rigorous, with offices organized around a central core.
The two major spaces have notable spatial quality, triple height, and natural roof lighting.
The peripheral structure provides flexibility for the offices, while interior walls define the major spaces.
The facade expresses the regularity of the offices and provides solar and acoustic protection.
The project attracted the jury through its efficiency, simplicity, and functional qualities.
The volumetric and typological choices meet programmatic needs and costs easily.

negative.statement: The privileged clearance spaces are not addressed and are relegated to blind rear corridors.
The seminar room has less convincing proportions and does not exploit verticality to relate to the office floor.
The composition is considered somewhat too rigid, with long corridors in places.
The additional perforated glass screen is redundant and increases overall cost.
The outdoor facilities ultimately fragment the campus entrance despite their gentle integration strategy.
Protection against summer overheating is a weakness in the construction-ecology assessment.
The significant height of auditoriums and classrooms disadvantages maintenance and acoustic management.
The project should establish a greater relationship between teaching and administrative areas.
A temporary carrier at the lower ground floor café area would improve the structural situation.
